name: STRATUS
recent: Stratus Global 宣布 2027 财年首次中期股息每股 0.80 仙，并公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩。EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报股权变动，包括成为大股东及不再是大股东的通知。主席 Fazrin Azwar 在 8 月至 10 月期间三次减持股份。
notable: 宣布 2027 财年首次中期股息每股 0.80 仙。
公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩。

risks: 主席 Fazrin Azwar 在 2026 年 8 月 27 日、9 月 22 日和 10 月 2 日三次减持股份。
EPF 在 10 月 8 日申报不再是大股东。

recent_en: Stratus Global declared a first interim dividend of 0.80 sen per share for FY2027 and announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026. EPF filed multiple substantial shareholder changes between October and November, including notices of becoming and ceasing to be a substantial shareholder. Chairman Fazrin Azwar disposed of shares three times between August and October.
notable_en: Declared a first interim dividend of 0.80 sen per share for FY2027.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
EPF filed multiple substantial shareholder changes between October and November, including notices of becoming and ceasing to be a substantial shareholder.
risks_en: Chairman Fazrin Azwar disposed of shares on 27 August, 22 September and 2 October 2026.
EPF filed a notice of ceasing to be a substantial shareholder on 8 October.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM34,844,000, net income was RM9,548,000, with a net margin of 27.4%.
